content.short: Xcockpit lets you interact with contracts on EVM chains via an Etherscan-like interface.
content.description: Xcockpit offers an Etherscan-style dapp that lets you interact with any contract on any EVM-compatible chain, whether the contract is verified or not, including your own local network. The interface makes querying and interacting with contracts straightforward, with a clean, familiar explorer experience. It also provides a one-click tool to view pending transactions and cancel them quickly. This combination makes contract exploration and management on multiple chains simpler and faster.
content.meta: Xcockpit is a dapp for interacting with contracts on EVM chains. Discover Xcockpit and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
